g.title: public.availability_rules
g.text: Recurring weekly hours in LOCATION-LOCAL time (survives DST). Overlaps per staff/day are impossible: no_overlapping_hours exclusion constraint (timerange custom type).

g.title: public.staff
g.text: Employees. Linked 1:1 to auth.users via user_id. Deactivated (active=false), never deleted. Self-editable personal fields are guarded by trg_guard_staff_self_update.
Whether this person appears as a provider in scheduling (columns, qualification pickers, slot search).

g.title: public.availability_rules:staff_id->public.staff:id
g.text: FOREIGN KEY (staff_id) REFERENCES staff(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

g.title: public.locations
g.text: IANA timezone driving availability math and notification formatting. Change with care: weekly hours are interpreted in this zone.
Sales tax in basis points (800 = 8%). Applied to taxable transaction items (retail); services are non-taxable in GA.
